title: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line Module 4 Lesson 1: Reading Graphs custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A velocity-time graph for a particle moving along a straight line connects the points $(0, 4)$ and $(8, 20)$ with a single straight line segment, where velocity is measured in $\text{m s}^{-1}$ and time in seconds. Find the acceleration of the particle.
A velocity-time graph consists of a straight line segment joining $(0, 4)$ to $(8, 20)$. Find the distance travelled by the particle during these $8\text{ s}$.

The displacement-time graph for a runner moving along a straight track is a straight line passing through $(2, 14)$ and $(7, 44)$, where displacement is measured in metres from a fixed origin and time in seconds. Find the speed of the runner.

A particle accelerates uniformly from rest to a speed of $18\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $6\text{ s}$, and immediately decelerates uniformly to rest over the subsequent $4\text{ s}$. Find the average speed of the particle over the entire $10\text{ s}$ journey.

The displacement-time graph for a car accelerating from rest at $t = 0$ is a parabola passing through the origin. Given that the car travels $45\text{ m}$ during the first $6\text{ s}$, find the constant acceleration of the car.
A velocity-time graph consists of a straight line segment joining $(0, 12)$ to $(6, -6)$. Find the total distance travelled by the particle between $t = 0$ and $t = 6$.

questions.prompt: The motion of a commuter train travelling between two stations $A$ and $B$ along a straight track is modeled by a velocity-time graph consisting of three straight line segments. The train accelerates uniformly from rest at $A$ for $30\text{ s}$ until reaching a speed of $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It then maintains this constant speed for a period of $T\text{ s}$, before decelerating uniformly to rest at station $B$ over a period of $20\text{ s}$. The total distance between the two stations is $2160\text{ m}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the train during the first $30\text{ s}$, and calculate the distance travelled while the train is decelerating.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the length of time $T$ for which the train is travelling at constant speed, and state the total time taken for the journey from $A$ to $B$.

questions.prompt: The displacement $s$ metres of a remote-controlled buggy from an origin $O$ at time $t$ seconds ($0 \le t \le 24$) is modeled by a displacement-time graph. The buggy starts from rest at $O$ and accelerates uniformly for $6\text{ s}$ until reaching displacement $s = 36\text{ m}$ (represented by a parabolic segment). It then travels at constant speed from $t = 6$ to $t = 16$, reaching displacement $s = 156\text{ m}$ (represented by a straight line segment). From $t = 16$ to $t = 24$, it decelerates uniformly to rest at displacement $s = 204\text{ m}$ (represented by a parabolic segment).

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the constant acceleration of the buggy during the first $6\text{ s}$, and find its constant speed during the interval $6 \le t \le 16$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the constant deceleration of the buggy during the final $8\text{ s}$, and calculate the average speed of the buggy over the entire $24\text{ s}$ journey.

questions.prompt: An elevator in an observation tower moves vertically. Its motion is modeled by a velocity-time graph consisting of straight line segments. On the ascent from the ground floor, the elevator accelerates uniformly from rest for $3\text{ s}$ to a speed of $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$, travels at $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $8\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest in $5\text{ s}$ at the viewing deck. The elevator remains stationary at the viewing deck for $12\text{ s}$. It then accelerates downwards to a speed of $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ over $2\text{ s}$, travels downwards at $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $6\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest at the ground floor over $2\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the upward acceleration during the first $3\text{ s}$, and calculate the height of the viewing deck above the ground floor.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that the elevator returns to the ground floor, find the value of $V$, and calculate the total time elapsed from the initial departure to the final stop.

questions.prompt: The velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ of a particle moving in a straight line from a fixed point $O$ is shown for $0 \le t \le 18$. The graph consists of straight line segments joining $(0, 8)$, $(4, 8)$, $(10, -4)$, and $(18, 0)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the particle during the interval $4 \le t \le 10$, and find the time at which the particle is at its greatest distance from $O$, calculating this maximum displacement.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the total distance travelled by the particle between $t = 0$ and $t = 18$, and calculate its final displacement from $O$ at $t = 18$.

questions.prompt: Two vehicles, $P$ and $Q$, travel between two roundabouts $1200\text{ m}$ apart along a straight road. Vehicle $P$ accelerates uniformly from rest for $20\text{ s}$ to speed $U\text{ m s}^{-1}$, maintains this speed for $40\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest in $20\text{ s}$. Vehicle $Q$ accelerates uniformly from rest for $15\text{ s}$ to speed $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$, maintains this speed for $T\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest in $25\text{ s}$. Both vehicles cover the same total distance of $1200\text{ m}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $U$ for vehicle $P$, and calculate its acceleration during the first $20\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $T$ for vehicle $Q$, and determine which vehicle completes the journey in less time and by how many seconds.

questions.prompt: A test car travels along a straight track from rest at $t = 0$ to rest at $t = T$. The velocity-time graph consists of four straight line segments joining $(0, 0)$, $(6, 18)$, $(14, 18)$, $(20, V)$, and $(T, 0)$, where $v$ is measured in $\text{m s}^{-1}$ and $t$ in seconds. Between $t = 14$ and $t = 20$, the car accelerates uniformly at $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to reach speed $V$. From $t = 20$ to $t = T$, the car decelerates uniformly at $3\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to come to rest.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $V$, the duration of the braking phase, and the total time $T$ taken for the complete journey.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the total distance travelled by the car from $t = 0$ to $t = T$, and find its average speed for the entire journey, giving your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.prompt: A mining hoist carrying ore of total mass $800\text{ kg}$ is raised vertically from the bottom of a shaft to the surface. The hoist starts from rest and accelerates uniformly upwards at $1.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $5\text{ s}$ to reach speed $u_1$. It travels at constant speed $u_1$ for $15\text{ s}$. It then decelerates uniformly at $0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $5\text{ s}$ to a lower speed $u_2$. Finally, it decelerates uniformly to rest at the surface over a further $4\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the speeds $u_1$ and $u_2$, and calculate the total depth of the shaft.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Taking $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$, find the tension in the hoisting cable during the first stage (upward acceleration) and during the third stage (deceleration to $u_2$).
